create_SharedBackboneMultipleHeads: create a SharedBackboneMultipleHeads module with a backbone, input name, and backbone output name
add_head_to_backbone_output: add a head to a specific backbone output with a head name, head module, and optional backbone output name
add_head: add a head module to the shared backbone with a head name and head module
add_heads: add multiple head modules to the shared backbone by name using keyword arguments
build_shared_backbone: build a shared backbone with multiple heads that share coordinate mappings across outputs
